changeSet.author: openelis
changeSet.comment: A deployment that recorded a case before the description columns became unbounded text and before decalcification was tracked: one case whose gross description fills the old 255-character column exactly, built with repeat() so no one has to count it, and one case standing at decalcification, which the upgrade must flag.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.sample (id, accession_number, entered_date, received_date, lastupdated) VALUES (990301, 'GRS26000000001', now(), now(), now()), (990302, 'GRS26000000002', now(), now(), now());
INSERT INTO clinlims.pathology_sample (id, sample_id, status, last_updated, gross_exam) VALUES (990301, 990301, 'GROSSING', now(), repeat('x', 255)), (990302, 990302, 'DECALCIFICATION', now(), NULL);
